item.title: Fire Traffic Alert: Old Houston Road-242 / 1314 Area – Vehicle Fire
item.description: 7:50 p.m. A van is on fire at the Peaceful Pines RV Park on Old Houston Road near Payne Road. The vehicle was already fully involved when firefighters arrived and is threatening an RV.

item.title: CENTRAL TEXAS POLICE OFFICER AMBUSHED AND KILLED
item.description: Police Officer Elijah Garretson was ambushed and killed near the intersection of Lost Trail and Great Hills Drive while responding to reports of a suspicious person on Saturday.
